subjects.heroTitle: Pathways designed for the Quebec curriculum
subjects.heroSubtitle: Four core subjects, from primary to secondary, with continuous progression and clear objectives.

mathematiques.title: Mathematics
mathematiques.shortDescription: Arithmetic, algebra, geometry, statistics — with progressive reasoning.
mathematiques.longDescription: A complete pathway that follows the Quebec program's progression. Each concept is introduced with a concrete example, then practiced through progressive exercises, before being consolidated with open-ended problems.

francais.title: French
francais.shortDescription: Reading, writing, grammar and oral communication.
francais.longDescription: An approach that favors fine-grained comprehension over rote memorization of rules. Exercises span genres (narrative, informative, argumentative) and feedback consistently explains the why rather than only the verdict.

sciences.title: Sciences
sciences.shortDescription: Natural sciences and technology, from Cycle 2 through secondary.
skills: Explore the world of science and technology
Make use of tools, objects and processes
sciences.longDescription: A subject where hands-on investigation drives understanding. Activities start from a concrete question, propose an investigation, then invite generalization. Concepts are consistently tied back to everyday life.

histoire.title: History and geography
histoire.shortDescription: History of Quebec, Canada and the world, geography and citizenship.
skills: Examine social realities from a historical perspective
Interpret social realities using the historical method
Build a citizen awareness through history
histoire.longDescription: A pathway that emphasizes reading of sources and connecting events. Exercises work on chronology, document analysis and historical writing, without falling into date-only memorization.

about.heroSubtitle: EduQuiz is a Quebec initiative, bilingual from day one, with Law 25 treated as a starting constraint rather than an afterthought.
about.missionDescription: Make adaptive learning accessible to Quebec primary and secondary students, in both official languages, with no ads, no data reselling, and no compromise on pedagogical quality.

about.value2Description: Data stays in Quebec, is never sold, and can be exported or deleted at any time. Law 25 is our floor, not our ceiling.

faq.heroTitle: The questions that come up most often
faq.heroSubtitle: If you can't find your answer here, write to us — we respond to everything.

items.q1: What ages is EduQuiz designed for?
items.a1: EduQuiz covers Grade 3 through Secondary 5, with fine level adjustment within each subject. Younger learners may also benefit from specific domains.
items.q2: Is the tool aligned with the PFEQ?
items.a2: Yes. Pathways follow the Quebec school's training program. Objectives displayed before each chapter map to the corresponding disciplinary competencies.
items.a3: Data is hosted in Quebec, encrypted, never resold, and you can access, export or delete it at any time. See the Privacy page for details.
items.q4: Do I have to pay to start?
items.a4: No. The Discovery plan is permanently free and covers two subjects of your choice. You only move to a paid plan if you want to.
items.a5: The iOS and Android app arrives in Phase 2. The current web site is fully responsive and usable on phones.
items.q6: Can I create an account for my whole family?
items.a6: Yes. The Family+ plan supports up to 4 learner profiles under a single parent account, with individual reports and a consolidated dashboard.

privacy.heroSubtitle: What we collect, why, and how you can exercise your rights.
paragraphs: Solutions Infos inc., a Quebec company based in Montreal, operates EduQuiz and acts as data controller within the meaning of Quebec Law 25.
Data collection is limited to what is strictly necessary: account identifiers, exercise answers, progress, language preferences, technical logs.
Data is hosted in Quebec (Montreal), encrypted at rest and in transit. It is never sold or shared with commercial third parties.
Your rights: access, rectification, portability, deletion, withdrawal of consent. They can be exercised from the account Settings or by email to privacy@solutions-infos.quebec.
Retention: learning data is kept for 24 months after last activity then anonymized. Technical logs are kept for 90 days maximum.
Processors: hosting is provided by a vendor whose servers are located in Quebec. Transactional emails are sent by a Canadian provider. A complete list is available on request.

terms.heroSubtitle: The rules for using the service, in plain language.
paragraphs: By creating an EduQuiz account, you accept these terms. If you are acting on behalf of a minor student, you must be legally entitled to do so.
The service is provided as-is, intended to support learning. It is not a substitute for schooling or professional pedagogical advice.
An account is strictly personal. Sharing credentials between multiple people is forbidden; family plans exist precisely to cover multi-user usage.
You agree to use the service legally and respectfully: no offensive content, no attempt to bypass security, no automated scraping.
We may suspend an account in case of serious or repeated violations of these terms. Data remains available for export for 30 days after suspension.
Termination is possible at any time from the account area. Amounts already charged are not refunded pro rata, except as required by law.

cookies.heroSubtitle: Which cookies we use, what for, and how to refuse them.
paragraphs: EduQuiz uses a limited number of cookies, strictly necessary for the service to function or for its security. No advertising cookie, no third-party commercial tracker.
Strictly necessary cookies: authenticated session, CSRF protection, language preference. They do not require your consent because the service cannot function without them.
Analytics cookies: enabled only with your explicit consent. Statistics are aggregated and do not let us re-identify you personally.
You can change your preferences at any time in the account Settings or delete cookies from your browser. Refusing optional cookies does not affect service availability.
Retention: session cookies expire when the browser closes. Language preference cookies last 12 months. Analytics cookies last 13 months maximum (CAI standard).

accessibility.heroSubtitle: Our commitment so that everyone can learn with EduQuiz.
paragraphs: EduQuiz targets WCAG 2.1 Level AA conformance. Each page is audited before release and feedback from users with disabilities is prioritized.

Applied principles: sufficient contrast, adjustable text size without content loss, full keyboard navigation, text alternatives for all meaningful images, clear semantic structure (headings, lists, landmarks).
Known improvement areas: some progress charts do not yet provide exhaustive text alternatives. A remediation plan is in progress.
Reporting a problem: write to accessibility@solutions-infos.quebec describing the observed behavior, the page involved and your assistive tool. We respond within 5 business days.
Conformance: this statement is updated annually or after any significant product change.

loi25.heroSubtitle: How EduQuiz complies with the Act respecting the protection of personal information in the private sector, as modernized by Law 25.
paragraphs: Privacy officer: the person in charge within Solutions Infos inc. can be reached at privacy@solutions-infos.quebec.
Transparency: the privacy policy describes in plain language the data collected, the purposes, and any third parties involved. Substantial changes are notified by email and announced on this page.
Consent: any collection not strictly necessary to the service requires explicit, granular consent that can be withdrawn at any time without friction.
Minimization and retention: only data useful to the service is collected; it is kept only as long as strictly required, then anonymized or deleted.
Rights of individuals: access, rectification, portability, deletion, withdrawal of consent, de-indexing. Each request is processed within 30 days.
Privacy Impact Assessment (PIA): carried out before any significant product change. Documentation is available on request from partner schools.
Incident: in case of a breach likely to cause serious harm, notification to the Commission d'accès à l'information and to affected individuals as soon as reasonably possible.
